paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5.69 as of July 31, representing a decrease of 15.45% from the prior close and 33.22% over the last 22 trading sessions. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

Fermi Inc. is in the news due to Cetera Investment Advisers raising its stock position in the company by 3,262.3% during the 1st quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. This news was reported by MarketBeat on August 2.

There have been various recent SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. Additionally, there has been one Form 4 filing and 16 proxy solicitation filings in the feed.
